newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BRUINS' MALLETTE, LEAFS' CRAIG SUSPENDED TWO GAMES EACH.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BRUINS' MALLETTE, LEAFS' CRAIG SUSPENDED TWO GAMES EACH.

text.p: The National Hockey League suspended and fined the Boston Bruins' Troy Mallette and the Toronto Maple Leafs' Mike Craig on Tuesday for their actions in separate incidents.
Bruins left wing Mallette was suspended for two games without pay and fined $1,000 for a flagrant elbowing incident against Dallas Stars' forward Grant Marshall in a January 4 game at Boston.
Leafs right wing Mike Craig was also suspended two games and fined $1,000 for highsticking Vancouver Canucks forward Mike Sillinger in a game the same day at Vancouver.
The fines are the maximum allowed under the collective bargaining agreement.

Marshall suffered a concussion when he was elbowed by Mallette at the 13:44 mark of the second period and is expected to miss at least one week. Mallette received a major penalty for elbowing and a game misconduct.
Mallette will miss the Bruins games at Philadelphia Tuesday and against Montreal on Thursday.
The highsticking incident involving Craig occurred at the 14:59 mark of the second period and Craig was assessed a match penalty for attempt to injure.
Craig will miss the Maple Leafs' game Tuesday at Calgary and on Saturday against Colorado.
